name: brief/commission
summary: A coordinator's proposed new fellow, shown before it is made: who it is, where it runs, and one state (Proposed, Creating, Created, Not created) that the same page updates in place.
intents: here's the fellow, good to go
not_for: a status of many pieces of work

slots.name: headline
slots.says: H1 for the state: Proposed 'Here's the fellow. Good to go?'; Creating 'Creating <name>'; Created '<name> is ready'; Not created '<name> was not created'

slots.name: lede
slots.says: one line: what the fellow will do for the person, in their words

slots.name: state
slots.says: exactly one of: Proposed, Creating, Created, Not created

slots.name: state_dot
slots.says: the kit dot for the state: n for Proposed, h for Creating, p for Created, f for Not created

slots.name: state_line
slots.says: Proposed: 'Reply yes go in to create it.'; Creating: 'Making it now.'; Created: a link to the fellow, Open ; Not created: why, in one line (you said no, or what failed)

slots.name: department
slots.says: the department it joins (one the coordinator is a member of)

slots.name: purpose
slots.says: what it is for, one or two sentences

slots.name: runs_on
slots.says: where it runs: 'This Mac' or 'Not running yet' (never the cloud)

slots.name: ask
slots.says: Proposed: 'yes go' to create it, or no; after: what the person answered and when

slots.name: room
slots.says: the room the answer is given in, e.g. #office

slots.name: updated
slots.says: when this state was written, UTC, from the clock

finish_line.says: one H1, and it says the state in words
links the tunnel kit, so it renders in every viewer
no stylesheet or script from another host (the kit is ours)
250 visible words at most: the person reads it beside the room
state, then the fellow, then the go
an Answer / In / Proposed by block
the state is one of Proposed, Creating, Created, Not created, and its dot matches (n, h, p, f); copper means Created and nothing else
the coordinator edits this artifact through each state; it never seeds a second one for the same fellow
works at 400px wide and in dark mode
private (the default): the person and the coordinator only
